## Carlotta (G4)

**Carlotta** is a minor *+Earth-pony mare** seen among the elegantly dressed Canterlot crowds, especially at the Grand Galloping Gala. The fan catalog gives her a pale sky-blue coat, bright orange mane, and light lavender eyes. One fan's description also notes a decorative updo, pearls, and formal clothing, though its hair/eye-color description differs from the catalog.

**Appearances:** *The Best Night Ever* (S1E26, first catalogued at roughly 12:07), *Sweet and Elite* (S2E09), *Princess Twilight Sparkle – Part 1* (S4E01), and *Make New Friends but Keep Discord* (S5E07). She has **no verified individual dialogue or voice-actor credit**; no established story role or secret identity.

**Name:** “Carlotta” is a **fan-reference name**, not verified here as an on-screen, credited, or Hasbro merchandise name. **“Giselle”** appears as an alternate fan label. How either label was first chosen is unverified; neither denotes a confirmed separate persona.

**Sources:** [MLP Wiki's Earth-pony mare list](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares); [fan visual description](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/1140325/manual-character-list-canterlot-nobility); [fan use of “Carlotta (Giselle)”](https://fanon.fandom.com/wiki/The_Unsung_Lullaby).
